one_liner: Nifty 50 surges 1.85% amid mixed global cues and strong FII inflows.

drivers.title: FII Inflows
drivers.detail: FII net inflow was Rs 4,479.08 Cr.

drivers.title: Global Market Influence
drivers.detail: US markets fell sharply, impacting sentiment.

flows_line: FII and DII both posted strong net inflows, Rs 4,479.08 Cr and Rs 4,018.72 Cr respectively.
watch_next: Watch for Tokyo Core CPI data at 09:00 IST tomorrow for potential market impact.
lesson_seeds: Nifty 50 showed strong performance with a 1.85% rise.
FII inflows continue to support market sentiment.
Global market downturns can still affect local sentiment.
Sectoral gains led by Pharma indicate selective market strength.
